name: support-desk
description: Answers questions and handles issues: one thread per request, triage, escalations and a record of what was learned.
welcome: Ask in #requests, one thread per question. Agents answer first where they can; a person takes over anything they cannot. Known answers go to #answers.

sections.name: Intake
sections.rules: One request a thread: what you tried, what you expected, what happened.

sections.name: Team
sections.rules: Hand over in the thread, never in private.

channels.name: requests
channels.purpose: New questions and issues, one thread each

channels.name: urgent
channels.rules: Say who is blocked and since when.

channels.name: triage
channels.purpose: Who takes which request, and its priority

channels.name: answers
channels.purpose: Answers worth keeping, one a post
channels.rules: The question, the answer and where it applies.
